b01: Every trip starts the same way. Three days before the flight, a suitcase open on the bed, and a tiny voice in your head asking... did I forget something?
b02: Yes. You did. It was the charger. It's always the charger.
b03: Travelers face three eternal enemies. Packing too much. Packing too little. And that magical moment at the airport when the scale says two kilos over.
b04: Meanwhile, the forecast says rain in Tokyo, and you packed sandals. Bold choice.
b05: Meet PackPal. The packing list that actually checks the weather, and knows what you're planning to do.
b06: Start by choosing your destination. Just type, and PackPal finds the place for you.
b07: Pick your dates, and it pulls the real forecast for exactly those days.
b08: Then tell it what you're up to. Hiking, city tours, great food, photos. Every plan adds the right gear.
b09: One tap. Your trip is ready.
b10: A live departures board counts down to takeoff. No more, I'll start packing tomorrow.
b11: Your list is built from the forecast and your activities. Warm layers if it's cold, rain gear if it's wet, and gear for everything you planned.
b12: Tick items off as you pack, and watch your progress and estimated luggage weight update. Goodbye, overweight fees.
b13: Add your own items, search the list, or jump into packing mode for a clean, focused view.
b14: But packing is only the beginning. PackPal is your whole pre-trip brain. Visas, flights, passports, hotel, budget, and local guides, all in one place.
b15: Before you fly, PackPal checks entry and visa requirements for your destination, so there are no surprises at the gate.
b16: Keep your flights in one place, with a live countdown, flight status, and even a return leg.
b17: Store your passports, and get a friendly warning when one has less than six months left. Then tick off your pre-flight checklist.
b18: Once you've landed in your plans, the Destination tab is your pocket guide. Weather for your whole stay, and your hotel with its photo, address and map, filled in from just the name.
b19: Emergency numbers, a spending money estimate, airport info, how to get around, and what to do when you get there.
b20: Share your list on WhatsApp, as a beautiful boarding pass image, or print it.
b21: Traveling with family or friends? Share the trip and everyone packs together, in real time. Finally, you can find out who forgot the sunscreen.
b22: And the best part? No download, no account needed. Open it, and go. Your trips stay on your device, unless you choose to sync them.
b23: PackPal. Pack smarter. Travel lighter. And be the person who remembers the charger.
